label: Extremely confident a2 choice (high value) at GO / unrewarded D1
explanation: Fires only at fixation-input steps (GO 74% of mass, D1 26%), never at D2, and only when the agent is about to choose a2 (100% of activations have action == 2, next_stay ~ 1, good mostly S2). It tracks the extreme tail of the agent policy: all GO activations fall in the lowest choice-logit bin (logit(a1)-logit(a2) < -8.9) with value in the high 7.73-8.10 bin; GO & choice < -10 & value > 7.8 is 94% precise but low recall. D1 activations occur mostly when the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew 0) while a2 preference is still strong. Concentrated in episode trials 10-49, absent late in episodes (80+) and in the first 10 trials. Within a run of repeated a2 trials the activation often decays from trial to trial. It does not fire for a1 choices, on rewarded-D1 inputs, or at D2. Recorded predicate uses only the model value/policy outputs at that step (no future variables); precision is limited because many equally confident a2 GO steps do not cross threshold, so the thresholded gate is an incomplete readout of a2 confidence.
